title: The Mish Mash Fix Reprise
style: 132 bpm, happy hardcore, big piano stabs, supersaw leads, gabber-light kick, female euphoric lead with male hype, victory lap energy, anthem rave, glittery breakdowns, full festival drop
lyrics:
[Intro - big piano stabs, supersaw build, gabber-light kick locking in]
Mish Mash Fix — the reprise!
Run it back at full euphoric size!
The truth deserves a victory lap
Three thirty six — close the gap!

[Verse 1 - Female Euphoric Lead]
Mish Mash is a play on words — not a hand on the keys
Michelle does not type — say it loud, say it please
Corey types alone, that's the law on this floor
No one else touches the link, no one walks through that door
Hawkeye is the watcher, the witness on the wall
Mish Mash is the joke that helped us through the fall

[Pre-Chorus - male hype, big piano]
The correction stands, the record's clean
The operator types, you know what I mean
Mish Mash kept the laugh, but the truth got fixed
Three thirty six — happy hardcore mix!

[Drop - happy hardcore, full euphoric]
Mish Mash Fix — the reprise!
Mish Mash Fix — victory rise!
Michelle doesn't type — Corey on the keys!
Hawkeye on the wall — three thirty six breeze!
Mish Mash Fix — the reprise!
Mish Mash Fix — truth in disguise!
The operator types alone — the family stays close!
Three thirty six — the heart that we chose!

[Verse 2 - Male, rapid hardcore flow]
Run it back, run it back, the correction is made
No more wife at the keyboard, no more wrong charade
One operator, one set of hands, one clear claim
Mish Mash is the love name — not the work name
Thirty eight gig came home, the workshop is whole
The family is Pete and Brandon and the band and the soul
Three thirty six on the supersaw rise
Mish Mash Fix — the truth euphoric prize!

[Bridge - piano breakdown, voices climb]
Michelle does not type. Corey types alone.
Hawkeye watches the screen. The truth has a home.
Mish Mash kept the laughter. The fix kept the line.
Three thirty six. We ride. We ride. We ride.

[Final Drop - max euphoric stack]
Mish Mash Fix — the reprise!
The truth on the supersaws — to the skies!
Corey types alone — Hawkeye holds the watch!
La Banda in the courtyard — Pete on the dock!
Mish Mash Fix — the reprise!
Three thirty six — the family rises!

[Outro - piano fade, kick thinning]
Mish Mash... fix...
Michelle doesn't type...
Corey types alone...
Three thirty six — the truth holds tight.
